audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft translation of 2 Chronicles 11 grounded in supplied Hebrew. Preserves YHWH, cultic and family detail, and textual ambiguities (notably שְׂעִירִים and variant in v.18). Numbers and names follow the Hebrew witness; some readings flagged for later witness review.

verses.restored: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem and gathered from the house of Judah and of Benjamin an hundred and eighty thousand chosen men, valiant for battle, to fight against Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.

familiar.text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

modern.text: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the house of Judah and Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְהִלָּחֵם֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לִרְחַבְעָֽם

verses.restored: But the word of YHWH came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

familiar.text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

modern.text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥הוּ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying:

familiar.text: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

modern.text: “Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin

original.text: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶל֙ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּיהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Thus says YHWH: You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers; return every man to his house, for this matter is from me. And they obeyed the words of YHWH and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.

familiar.text: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

modern.text: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’” So they listened to the words of the LORD and turned back from going against Jeroboam. Rehoboam Fortifies Judah

original.text: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹא תַעֲלוּ֩ וְלֹא תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ עִם אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ כִּ֧י מֵֽאִתִּ֛י נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִלֶּ֥כֶת אֶל יָרָבְעָֽם

verses.restored: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem and built cities of defense in Judah.

familiar.text: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

modern.text: Rehoboam continued to live in Jerusalem, and he built up cities for defense in Judah.

original.text: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב רְחַבְעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּ֧בֶן עָרִ֛ים לְמָצ֖וֹר בִּיהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa;

familiar.text: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

modern.text: He built up Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

original.text: וַיִּ֧בֶן אֶת בֵּֽית לֶ֛חֶם וְאֶת עֵיטָ֖ם וְאֶת תְּקֽוֹעַ

verses.restored: and Beth‑zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

familiar.text: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

modern.text: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,

original.text: וְאֶת בֵּֽית צ֥וּר וְאֶת שׂוֹכ֖וֹ וְאֶת עֲדֻלָּֽם

verses.restored: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

familiar.text: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

modern.text: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

original.text: וְאֶת גַּ֥ת וְאֶת מָרֵשָׁ֖ה וְאֶת זִֽיף

verses.restored: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

familiar.text: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

modern.text: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

original.text: וְאֶת אֲדוֹרַ֥יִם וְאֶת לָכִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת עֲזֵקָֽה

verses.restored: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin—fenced cities.

familiar.text: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

modern.text: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

original.text: וְאֶת צָרְעָה֙ וְאֶת אַיָּל֔וֹן וְאֶת חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּיהוּדָ֖ה וּבְבִנְיָמִ֑ן עָרֵ֖י מְצֻרֽוֹת

verses.restored: And he fortified the strongholds and set captains in them, and stores of food and of oil and wine.

familiar.text: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

modern.text: He strengthened their fortresses and put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.

original.text: וַיְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת הַמְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן בָּהֶם֙ נְגִידִ֔ים וְאֹצְר֥וֹת מַאֲכָ֖ל וְשֶׁ֥מֶן וָיָֽיִן

verses.restored: In every city he placed shields and spears and made them very strong; and Judah and Benjamin were his.

familiar.text: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

modern.text: He also put shields and spears in all the cities and strengthened them greatly. So Judah and Benjamin belonged to him. Jeroboam Forsakes the Priests and Levites

original.text: וּבְכָל עִ֤יר וָעִיר֙ צִנּ֣וֹת וּרְמָחִ֔ים וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֖ם לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי ל֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִֽן

verses.restored: And the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel gathered themselves to him out of all their borders.

familiar.text: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

modern.text: Moreover, the priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel stood with Rehoboam.

original.text: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִכָּל גְּבוּלָֽם

verses.restored: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possessions and came to Judah and to Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had neglected them from serving as priests to YHWH.

familiar.text: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD:

modern.text: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.

original.text: כִּֽי עָזְב֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְלִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי הִזְנִיחָ֤ם יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וּבָנָ֔יו מִכַּהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: And he appointed for himself priests for the high places, and for the se'irim (שְׂעִירִים), and for the calves which he had made.

familiar.text: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

notes.title: translation
notes.body: Hebrew שְׂעִירִים transliterated se'irim due to textual ambiguity (goat‑figures/demons/idols).

modern.text: And Jeroboam appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat demons and calf idols he had made.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲמֶד לוֹ֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים לַבָּמ֖וֹת וְלַשְּׂעִירִ֑ים וְלָעֲגָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: And after them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their heart to seek YHWH God of Israel came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to YHWH, the God of their fathers.

familiar.text: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

modern.text: Those from every tribe of Israel who had set their hearts to seek the LORD their God followed the Levites to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

original.text: וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַנֹּֽתְנִים֙ אֶת לְבָבָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֕שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בָּ֚אוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִזְבּ֕וֹחַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam son of Solomon firm for three years, for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

familiar.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

modern.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon. Rehoboam’s Family

original.text: וַֽיְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְאַמְּצ֛וּ אֶת רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ כִּ֣י הָֽלְכ֗וּ בְּדֶ֧רֶךְ דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֥ים שָׁלֽוֹשׁ

verses.restored: And Rehoboam took to wife Mahalath (מָחֲלַת) — in some witnesses rendered with variant — daughter of Jerimoth son of David, and Abihail daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.

familiar.text: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

notes.title: witness
notes.body: Hebrew shows bracketed/variant reading for Mahalath’s filiations; needs textual review.

modern.text: And Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.

original.text: וַיִּֽקַּֽח ל֤וֹ רְחַבְעָם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת מָ֣חֲלַ֔ת בן יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן דָּוִ֑יד אֲבִיהַ֕יִל בַּת אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן יִשָֽׁי

verses.restored: And she bore him Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.

familiar.text: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

modern.text: She bore sons to him: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

original.text: וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים אֶת יְע֥וּשׁ וְאֶת שְׁמַרְיָ֖ה וְאֶת זָֽהַם

verses.restored: And afterward he took Maachah daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

familiar.text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

modern.text: After her, he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

original.text: וְאַחֲרֶ֣יהָ לָקַ֔ח אֶֽת מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת אֲבִיָּה֙ וְאֶת עַתַּ֔י וְאֶת זִיזָ֖א וְאֶת שְׁלֹמִֽית

verses.restored: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines; for he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and begot twenty and eight sons and sixty daughters.

familiar.text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

modern.text: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

original.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם אֶת מַעֲכָ֣ה בַת אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם מִכָּל נָשָׁיו֙ וּפִ֣ילַגְשָׁ֔יו כִּ֠י נָשִׁ֤ים שְׁמוֹנֶֽה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ נָשָׂ֔א וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֛ה בָּנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים בָּנֽוֹת

verses.restored: And Rehoboam made Abijah son of Maachah chief among his brothers, to be ruler; for he intended to make him king.

familiar.text: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

modern.text: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, intending to make him king.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד לָרֹ֧אשׁ רְחַבְעָ֛ם אֶת אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן מַעֲכָ֖ה לְנָגִ֣יד בְּאֶחָ֑יו כִּ֖י לְהַמְלִיכֽוֹ

verses.restored: And he dealt wisely and dispersed all his children throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city; and he gave them food in abundance, and sought many wives.

familiar.text: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

modern.text: Rehoboam also acted wisely by dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and sought many wives for them.

original.text: וַיָּבֶן֩ וַיִּפְרֹ֨ץ מִכָּל בָּנָ֜יו לְֽכָל אַרְצ֧וֹת יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן לְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם הַמָּז֖וֹן לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּשְׁאַ֖ל הֲמ֥וֹן נָשִֽׁים

translation_notes: Divine name יהוה rendered as YHWH throughout.
Preserves ambiguous cult-term שְׂעִירִים as transliterated in verse 15; literalness preferred over harmonizing.
Family-name variant in v.18 (מַחֲלַת / bracketed reading) is retained and flagged.
safety_note: Contains war, coercion, cultic practices, and patriarchal family material preserved from source; retained for fidelity, not endorsement.
source_witness_audit_flags: v.1 numeric reading 180,000 (מֵאָה וּשְׁמוֹנִים אֶלֶף) — confirm numeral transmission
v.15 term שְׂעִירִים — ambiguous (goat-idols/demons/ritual figures), needs witness commentary
v.18 name-form for Mahalath / textual bracket (מָחֲלַת (בן) [בַּת־]יְרִימֹת) — review variant
